from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class CompanyFiling(BaseModel):
    """Financial data extracted from one company's filing."""
    company_name: str | None = Field(description="The company this filing belongs to")
    period_end_date: str | None = Field(description="The reporting period end date")
    accounts_payable_amount: float | None = Field(description="The accounts payable amount as reported; None if not found in this filing")
    accounts_payable_label: str | None = Field(description="The line-item label as written (e.g., 'Accounts payable', 'Accounts payable and accrued expenses')")
    accounts_payable_unit: str | None = Field(description="How the amount is expressed: 'dollars', 'thousands', 'millions'")
    quote: str | None = Field(description="Verbatim line containing the accounts payable figure")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    company_filing: list[CompanyFiling]
